newsitem.title: USA: Media General buys media co for $710 mln.
newsitem.headline: Media General buys media co for $710 mln.

text.p: Media General Inc said Tuesday it has completed its acquisition of Park Acquisitions Inc for $710 million in cash.
As a result, the company said it expects to post a first quarter charge of about $62 million, or $2.32 per share, from the redemption of $476 million in debt.
The deal adds 10 network affiliated television stations, 28 daily community newspapers and 82 weekly newspapers to Media General's media properties.
As part of the transaction, Media General said it will divest WTVR television station in Richmond, Va., where it also owns the Richmond Times-Dispatch newspaper.
It also has signed letters of intent to sell 18 of the former Park newspaper properties that are located principally outside the Southeast region of the country.
The company said the deal would solidify its presence in the Southeast's media market. It also said that leveraged free cash flow is expected to be positive from the start.
